theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_rectifiable_c1_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), CountablyRectifiable n M → ∃ (g : ℕ → Euclid n → Euclid P) (c : ℕ → Euclid n) (r m : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (g k)) ∧ (∀ k, 0 < m k) ∧ (∀ k, ∀ a ∈ ball (c k) (r k), ∀ b ∈ ball (c k) (r k), m k * ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖g k a - g k b‖) ∧ (∀ k, MeasurableSet (g k '' ball (c k) (r k))) ∧ (∀ k, μHE[n] (g k '' ball (c k) (r k)) ≠ ∞) ∧ μHE[n] (M \ ⋃ k, g k '' ball (c k) (r k)) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
